text: Code inspection localizes the admission discrepancy: ForwardMidpointExporter.inspect computes endpointRoundTrip, and on sigma3 11->12 its maxima exactly match independent evaluator 0.319271/0.557351 mm. ForwardMidpointExporter.admit currently thresholds each residual inverse and topology, then stores endpointRoundTrip without gating it. Endpoint diagnostics therefore already expose the error; future endpoint admission/optimization work can use this evidence without inventing a new metric. This study preserves its frozen exporter and independent gate.
